Interface BodyPartFilter

public interface BodyPartFilter
Strategy for deciding which exercises the Workout History page shows. Each filter knows its own chip label and its own rule, so the page never compares strings. Adding a BodyPart adds a chip and a working filter with no other edits.

A filter works on a BodyPart (null means none was recorded), so it has no dependency on any view class.
